visual_action: A montage of four still photographs of Democratic politicians. First, a man signs a bill at a desk, surrounded by smiling and clapping people, one of whom holds a sign. Second, another man in a light-colored shirt smiles while interacting with a woman who has her mouth open as if shouting and a man in a wheelchair. Third, an older man with white hair smiles while being hugged by a group of children. Fourth, a bald man in a suit speaks and points forward in a formal setting.

central_claim: The Democratic Party is defined by its inherent drive to protect vulnerable populations, provide for children, and stand up to Donald Trump.
intended_effect: To energize supporters and foster a sense of pride in the Democratic Party's core principles and its opposition to Trump.
